text:
ada: New hire hit a blocker in the python sample app. Async tool/function call throws when the tool returns a dataclass. Happens on 0.14.2 during onboarding.

ada: Error from container:
```
TypeError: Failed to coerce dataclass to json
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood/_struct.py", line 110, in _serialize_structured_output
    raise TypeError('Failed to coerce dataclass to json')
```

niko: Can you paste the minimal repro? are you returning a dataclass instance or dict from the tool?

ada: Returning dataclass instance. Quick repro:
```py
from dataclasses import dataclass
from redwood import AsyncClient

client = AsyncClient(api_key=ENV_TOKEN)

@dataclass
class Profile:
    username: str
    points: int

async def main():
    out = await client.call_tool(name='parse_profile', input={'raw':'alex,42'}, response_schema=Profile)
    print(out)
```

sam: This smells like the async coercer running under a ThreadPoolExecutor without our serializer hooks. Sync path handles dataclasses fine.

ivy: We also observed a related flake where an auth refresh on toolcall triggers a retry suppression and then the serialization error shows up instead of a clear auth failure. Logs look like:
```
[2026-03-21T08:12:01Z] POST /v1/toolcall -> 401 token_expired
[2026-03-21T08:12:01Z] auth refresh -> 200
[2026-03-21T08:12:01Z] retry: suppressed missing-idempotency
[2026-03-21T08:12:01Z] serialize -> TypeError
```

kyle-devex: Thanks for the well-scoped repro. Confirmed root causes: (1) async path coerces structured outputs in a threadpool but doesn't propagate runtime serializer hooks (so dataclass support is skipped); (2) token refresh + retry logic for toolcall can hide auth errors and surface them as serialization failures.

kyle-devex: Proposed fix: run coercer on the event loop (avoid threadpool) and add explicit retry on token refresh for toolcall + clearer error messages when coercion fails. Also adding a small mypy-friendly example in the sample app to show both dict and dataclass returns and the interim workaround.

ada: Workaround I used: return asdict(profile) inside the tool. But this breaks type annotations in examples and editor hints for newcomers. Mypy warns the function returns Dict instead of Profile which confuses onboarding.

sam: Can we add a unit/e2e test in CI that runs the sample-app matrix: sync/async x dataclass/dict returns? That would catch regressions early.

kyle-devex: Agreed. I'll open a hotfix PR today with tests + changelog and cut 0.14.3. I'll also add a short docs note recommending dict return in README until the patch lands, and then replace with dataclass-first sample once released.

ci-bot: build/sample-app (python-matrix) started for commit hotfix/async-coercer -> job #4987

kyle-devex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4012  includes fix + tests. Marked hotfix.

ada: Verified locally against PR branch  async toolcall now accepts dataclass returns, editors/mypy happy. Thanks!

ivy: I'll update onboarding checklist to mention the asdict() workaround until the release is promoted. Also filing a small follow-up to improve serializer diagnostics so users see "unsupported return type" instead of a generic TypeError.

sam: Thanks. Once cut, we'll bump sample-app dependency and notify docs.

ada: Closing loop  ping me if anyone else hits async-toolcall dataclass issues.
